lines: A weapon they might have used
could still be out there.
Just thinking about it takes me
right back to ancient times.
He's a giant in Islamic history.
Repelling the Crusaders is only
part of it.
It really moved you, Gerhard.
I got carried away.
Shall we get back to work?
Ian's interested in Asian history?
The Medusa Shield was on my mind.
They say it's in the Tasman Sea.
Your eyes reminded me of it.
What matters is what it meant.
What brings you here, Manuel?
That's a stern lesson.
We'd better stay on guard, then?
I just heard a tale about some
armor linked to Attila.
Only a rumor, mind you.
You know what an armadillo is?
Heard its hide's harder than iron.
You know what a giant tortoise is?
Heard its shell's harder than iron.
That's too little to go on.
Right. Now we have to make a living
on our own again. I envy
my great-grandfather's generation.
No one knows what made that sound
or whether science can explain
it as a natural phenomenon.
Back in the Gupta dynasty, someone
made a statue of a sacred beast.
Get this. It's supposed
to see the future!
Grr! What are they talking about?!
It makes you a master archer,
they say. Now they're asking
if it'll work with cannons.
And who's tending the ship? Nobody!
All this fuss over a silly rumor!
If it were that close, someone
would have found it by now!
I see. I'm glad it's yours again.
Y-you can't be serious, Admiral!
Go see them while you're here.
I'll give you directions.
Welcome, Hodram.
Another lovely day, isn't it?
Welcome, WWWWWWWWWWWWWWWW.
Another lovely day, isn't it?
Yes, let's.
(What a beautiful figurehead.
Just looking at it gave me
such a sense of peace...)
Here. It looks like a figurehead...
Ruins all over the world? Hmm...
We don't have any famous ones here.
Looking for ruins the world over?
I'm afraid we have none of note.
Yuris should be here somewhere.
Oh, no!
I forgot all about my estate!
Please, would you take me back?
